description: This file defines the BatchDelete class in the Aws\S3 namespace, which provides methods for batch deleting objects from an Amazon S3 bucket asynchronously and synchronously. The class includes static methods for creating batch delete operations from list results or iterators, manages batching, and handles Promise-based asynchronous requests.

classes.name: Aws\S3\BatchDelete
classes.description: A class to batch delete objects from an S3 bucket, supporting asynchronous deletion via promises and static factory methods for creating batch delete objects from list outputs or iterators.

methods.name: fromListObjects
methods.description: Creates a BatchDelete object based on the results of a ListObjects API call, setting up promises for each object to be deleted.

methods.name: fromIterator
methods.description: Creates a BatchDelete object from a custom iterator yielding objects to delete.

methods.name: promise
methods.description: Returns a promise that resolves when all queued delete operations are completed.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Executes the delete operations synchronously by waiting on the deletion promise.
